caption_L2L3: The GDP for Spain overall has increased since the start of data in 2008. The increase has not been uniform, with the GDP steadily decreasing until it reached its lowest around 2013, before starting an upwards trajectory towards present day. The GDP increased after 2013 at a faster rate than it was decreasing up until this time.
